Taskbar lyrics

  1. Load the bundled mod source in Windhawk. Compile it, then turn on Show lyrics on your taskbar widget.
  2. In MusicBee, use Preferences → Plugins → Add Plugin with the bundled MusicBee DLL, then restart MusicBee.
  3. Keep Verse Lab running while MusicBee plays. Taskbar mode moves Verse Lab to the system tray.
